description: This script manages post-installation tasks for bundled plugins in a software project, including discovering runtime dependencies, checking source checkout conditions, and running npm install for missing dependencies.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from a given path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency's package.json inside node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies for bundled plugins by scanning the extensions directory.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates an environment object for nested npm installs with certain configs removed.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Checks whether the current package root appears to be a source checkout with git, src directory, and extensions.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Determines if the postinstall process should run based on environment and directory conditions.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function to perform the postinstall steps including dependency installation.
